research_projects.title: Agentic AI for RIS/LOS Communication Switching
research_projects.description: An intelligent decision framework for RIS/LOS switching under blockage conditions in mmWave communication systems.
objectives: Predict blockage from beam-power sequences and visual information.
Combine CNN prediction, YOLO vehicle detection, and historical link states.

student_projects.title: Human-Vending Machine Interaction Detection
student_projects.funding_source: National University of Sciences and Technology
student_projects.description: A computer-vision system that predicts whether a person is interacting with a vending machine. Real-world video data were collected, labelled, and used to train a CNN-based binary interaction detector.
objectives: Detect human interaction and non-interaction with a vending machine.
Automate analysis of vending-machine engagement from camera footage.
Support insights into user behaviour, machine placement, and product availability.
outcomes: Built a working interaction detector and documented future improvements for interaction counting, expanded data collection, transfer learning, and real-time tracking.
